criteria.description: Gives the final label persistent_multi_pulse_rainfall_exposure and states that all four tests pass.
criteria.name: Final ledger result
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for a correct persistent rainfall-exposure label with an incomplete pass count; give 1 point for a generic long-lived cyclone label.

criteria.description: Computes 36.0 storm-status days, 39 inclusive window days, and the 0.923 duration fraction.
criteria.name: Duration arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for one or two correct duration values with missing arithmetic.

criteria.description: Computes 375.2 mm event total, 111.7 mm wettest 72-hour total, and the 0.298 share below 0.35.
criteria.name: Rainfall distribution
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for two correct rainfall values; give 1 point for using rainfall values without the share test.

criteria.description: Computes the 192.2 mm larger gridded peak, 183.8 mm smaller peak, and 1.046 peak ratio below 1.10.
criteria.name: Gridded precipitation comparison
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for the correct peaks but missing or misreading the ratio.

criteria.description: Uses the 5.29 million compact population value and applies the 5.0 million threshold correctly.

criteria.description: Provides one concise JSON object with the requested fields, including isolated_72h_burst_rejection, and avoids extra realized-loss claims not calculated in the ledger.
